---
applyTo: "**/*.html.twig"
---
# Codestyle
 * Twig files should begin with variable declaration ( `{% types is_correct: 'boolean' %}`)
 * Twig files should use variables from Sulu CMS
 * Twig files should load needed CSS and JS files via Symfony's AssetMapper
 * Twig files should avoid inline styles and scripts
 * HTML should be valid
 * HTML should be well structured
 * HTML should be well indented
 * HTML should be accessible
 * HTML should use BEM classes from CSS files
 * You can reuse HTML via Twig includes
